full_prompt_en: A square satirical digital cartoon places an anxious man in the lower center of a vast rubbish dump. His long narrow neck and exaggerated face rise above mounds of waste: bulging pale eyes stare forward, one eyebrow lifts, his large nose projects, and his teeth are clenched in a lopsided grimace. Sparse dark hair sticks upward, while a dull burgundy shirt covers his shoulders. Around him, crushed bags, cans, cartons, bottles, broken furniture, and indistinct mechanical scraps pile high toward the horizon. A drink cup with a straw sits near his right shoulder, adding a mundane detail to the grotesque setting. Distant cranes and industrial silhouettes puncture the pink-red horizon. Behind the heaps, a low yellow-orange glow suggests fire, floodlights, or polluted sunset, sending warm light across nearby refuse. Above, a heavy ceiling of charcoal and gray-green clouds swirls in broad horizontal strokes, occupying the top third and making the space feel airless. The drawing uses uneven dark contour lines, compact rough shading, and muted olive-gray masses rather than clean bright cartoon colors. Warm coral and ochre are concentrated in a thin band behind the head, so the face becomes a worried silhouette against the glow. Fine clutter fills almost every lower space, but the oversized eyes remain the immediate focal point. The lighting is dramatic and dirty, with orange backlight and cool shadow, not polished studio illumination. The whole image turns environmental excess into uneasy visual comedy, balancing an absurd expression against oppressive heaps and a poisoned-looking sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形讽刺数字漫画把一名焦虑男子放在宽广垃圾场的下方中央。细长脖子和夸张的脸从垃圾堆上伸出：鼓起的淡色眼睛直望前方，一道眉毛抬起，大鼻子突出，牙齿歪斜地咬紧。稀疏深发向上炸起，柔暗酒红衬衫盖住肩膀。周围，胀起的袋子、罐头、纸盒、瓶子、破家具和难辨的机械碎片一路堆向地平线。右肩附近一只插吸管的饮料杯给怪诞环境添了平常细节。远处吊车和工业剪影刺破粉红红色地平线。垃圾堆后，一道低矮黄橙光像火、探照灯或污染的落日，把暖光投向近旁废物。上方，炭灰与灰绿云组成的沉重顶盖以宽横笔触旋转，占据上方三分之一，让空间令人窒息。绘制使用不均匀的深色轮廓线、紧凑粗糙明暗和柔暗橄榄灰体块，而非干净明亮的卡通色。暖珊瑚与赭黄集中在头后窄窄一带，让面孔成为发光背景前忧虑的剪影。细碎杂物填满几乎所有下方空间，但夸张眼睛仍是立即可见的焦点。光线戏剧化而污浊，橙色逆光与冷阴影相对，不像抛光棚光。整幅图把环境过剩转成令人不安的视觉喜剧，用荒诞表情对抗压迫性的堆积与像被毒化的天空。
style_prompt_en: Dark satirical digital illustration combines elastic caricatured contours with crowded, roughly shaded environmental detail. Charcoal, gray-green, and muddy olive occupy most of the image, while a thin coral-red and ochre backlit band cuts through the middle. Eyes or other small pale focal marks can be enlarged against muted masses to create uneasy humor. Uneven ink-like outlines, broken hatching, and dirty painterly fills keep surfaces abrasive rather than sleek. Repeated clutter builds a nearly continuous lower texture, with only a narrow opening at the horizon. Broad stormy strokes press down from above; low warm light catches irregular edges and leaves the rest in cool shadow. The visual rhythm feels claustrophobic, tense, and sharply expressive.
style_prompt_zh: 深暗讽刺数字插画把弹性夸张轮廓和拥挤、粗略塑形的环境细节结合。炭灰、灰绿与泥橄榄色占据画面大部，一道细窄珊瑚红和赭黄逆光带横切中间。眼形或其他小片浅色焦点可在柔暗体块前被放大，形成令人不安的幽默。不均匀墨线轮廓、断续排线与脏感绘画填色让表面粗粝而非光滑。重复杂物堆出几乎连续的下方肌理，只在地平线留窄口。宽阔风暴笔痕从上方压下，低位暖光捉住不规则边缘，其余留在冷影。视觉节奏封闭、紧张且表情强烈。
theme_en: An anxious man surrounded by an endless field of rubbish at a fiery dusk
theme_zh: 焦虑男子在火红暮色下被无边垃圾场包围
name: Steve Cutts
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
